author: Milly barzellai (original File:Salvaronaldo.jpg); crops by User:Blackcat; uploaded by Im Fokus
date_taken: 2002 (Commons says 'on the day of the 2002 World Cup Final'; doubtful - see notes)
view_angle: frontal head-and-shoulders, slight left turn, smiling with upper incisors visible
notes: Tighter crop of Ronaldo_2002_cropped.jpg (same scanned print). Hair is a uniform ~0.5-1 cm buzz WITHOUT the Cascao front patch; green Nike CBF polo with 4 stars; stud earring in LEFT ear; thin chin-strap stubble. The Cascao cut was first photographed on 24 June 2002 and worn through 2 July 2002, so a 30 June date is inconsistent; likely earlier in 2002. Good for teeth/diastema, eyes, nose, ears; NOT for final-day hair. Logged by 01_appearance_2002 dossier.
